messages.subject: Map projection problem
parts:
Hi all,
I'm having some trouble plotting maps using ggplot2. The standard
projection (when the projection is not defined at all) works well but
any other projections start displaying strange artifacts. I include
here a code snippet for a Mercator projection map demonstrating the
problem. Anybody have an idea what is causing this?
Best,
Manu Tamminen


### R-code
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(mapproj)

measurements <- data.frame()
world <- map_data("world")

ggplot(measurements, aes(long, lat)) +
geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
colour = "grey70", fill = "grey70") +
coord_map(project="mercator") +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank(),
axis.title.y = theme_blank())
###
